title: rogiera latifolia
intro: Rogiera latifolia, commonly known as the West Indian jasmine, is a flowering plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Rogiera latifolia are attributed to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which can help in calming the mind and body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
